title: Leaving New Orleans for California
summary: He left New Orleans for California in 1936, returned, and moved out again in 1941.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well when did you leave New Orleans? How long have you been in California?
I've been in California, I left New Orleans in 1941.
I left New Orleans in 1936. And I stayed out here a while and I went back and I come back in 41 and I stayed. First time I came in, in 36. Then I come back in, and 41 and I stayed then.
